description: This file defines the Criteria class, which encapsulates filtering and pagination parameters such as start index, maximum count, code, and ordering direction for querying data.

classes.name: Criteria
classes.description: A model class for specifying query criteria including pagination and order details.

methods.name: getMaxCount
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of results to retrieve.

methods.name: setMaxCount
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of results to retrieve.

methods.name: getStartIndex
methods.description: Returns the starting index for the query pagination.

methods.name: setStartIndex
methods.description: Sets the starting index for pagination.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Retrieves the code associated with the criteria.

methods.name: setCode
methods.description: Sets the code associated with the criteria.

methods.name: getOrderBy
methods.description: Gets the criteria ordering (ascending or descending).

methods.name: setOrderBy
methods.description: Sets the criteria ordering (ascending or descending).
